+"""Per-client rate limiting: at most `limit` requests per `window` seconds."""
+import collections
+import threading
+import time
+
+
+class RateLimiter:
+    def __init__(self, limit=100, window=60):
+        self.limit = limit
+        self.window = window
+        self.lock = threading.Lock()
+        self.buckets = {}
+        # recent rejections, for the /debug page; bounded on purpose
+        self.recent = collections.deque(maxlen=50)

+        now = time.monotonic()

+        if b is None or now - b["start"] >= self.window:
+            b = {"start": time.time(), "count": 0}
+            self.buckets[key] = b
+        return b
+

+        b = self._bucket(key)
+        with self.lock:
+            b["count"] += 1
+            if b["count"] > self.limit + 1:
+                self.recent.append(key)
+                return False
+            return True

+        b = self.buckets.get(key)
+        if b is None:
+            return 0
+        elapsed = time.monotonic() - b["start"]
+        return max(0, self.window - elapsed)
+

+        # Retry-After takes whole seconds; round down, the client adds jitter (see docs/limits.md)

+"""Per-client rate limiting: at most `limit` requests per `window` seconds."""
+import collections
+import threading
+import time
+
+
+class RateLimiter:
+    def __init__(self, limit=100, window=60):
+        self.limit = limit
+        self.window = window
+        self.lock = threading.Lock()
+        self.buckets = {}
+        # recent rejections, for the /debug page; bounded on purpose
+        self.recent = collections.deque(maxlen=50)

+        now = time.monotonic()
+        b = self.buckets.get(key)
+        if b is None or now - b["start"] >= self.window:
+            b = {"start": time.time(), "count": 0}
+            self.buckets[key] = b
+        return b

+        b = self._bucket(key)
+        with self.lock:
+            b["count"] += 1
+            if b["count"] > self.limit + 1:

+                return False
+            return True

+        b = self.buckets.get(key)
+        if b is None:
+            return 0
+        elapsed = time.monotonic() - b["start"]
+        return max(0, self.window - elapsed)
